remarks: This fully renovated 3-bedroom, 2-bath ground-floor condo offers the perfect blend of modern style, comfort, and convenience. Designed for one-level living, the open layout is filled with natural light and sleek finishes, while a private patio provides seamless indoor-outdoor living-ideal for entertaining or unwinding. The modern kitchen features stainless steel appliances, while spacious bedrooms include a serene primary suite. Bright, airy living areas create a warm and inviting home for today's lifestyle. As part of the sought-after Rowayton Woods community, residents enjoy outstanding amenities: a sparkling in-ground pool, tennis courts, pond access, community garden, and beautifully maintained grounds. Perfectly located near downtown Rowayton, local shops, Norwalk amenities, and just a one-hour train ride to Manhattan, with access to top Rowayton schools. Whether as a primary residence or weekend retreat, this home offers the best of coastal living with modern convenience.
